# Mehdi Raoof

> Mehdi Raoof is a Senior SEO/GEO Lead with ten years growing organic and AI search
> traffic for e-commerce, travel, and agencies, four of them leading small
> multinational teams on large, multilingual sites. He works across technical SEO,
> automation, GEO/AEO/LLMO, and content strategy, and has driven over $100K a month
> in revenue from organic search alone. Notable results include +35% organic traffic
> and 8K to 150K pages indexed in a year at byFood, and +3000% blog organic traffic
> at Espard. He is open to senior SEO/GEO roles and consulting; email is the fastest
> way to reach him.

## Pages

- [Home / CV](https://mehdiraoof.github.io/): Full CV — impact metrics, focus areas, experience timeline (byFood, Voetbaltrips, The VArgo, Espard, Websima, Bamilo), skills, and contact.
- [Tools](https://mehdiraoof.github.io/tools/): Free SEO tools and Chrome extensions Mehdi built for his own work. PulseO (open source: Search Console data in Google Sheets with weekly and monthly reports), HTTP Status Checker for SEOs (live on the Chrome Web Store: bulk HTTP status checks from a pasted list or a CSV/XLSX file, results grouped by status code and exported as CSV), plus Page Pulse and Advanced Search for SEOs (in development).
- [PulseO](https://mehdiraoof.github.io/tools/pulseo/): Free, open source tool (MIT license) that copies Google Search Console data into your own Google Sheets every week, keeps history beyond Search Console's 16 months, and builds monthly and weekly reports with alarms and optional emailed PowerPoint decks.
- [PulseO Privacy Policy](https://mehdiraoof.github.io/tools/pulseo/privacy/): What Google data PulseO accesses, how it is used and stored, who it is shared with, and how to remove access.
- [PulseO Terms of Service](https://mehdiraoof.github.io/tools/pulseo/terms/): The terms for using PulseO, including no warranty and the MIT-licensed code.
